capabilities: Import lectures from the Alt desktop app or a share link as per-slide notes
Generate per-slide commentary and wikilinked concept notes via Claude Code or Codex CLI
View the slide PDF and note side by side with synced scrolling and a transcript panel
Ask questions about the current slide with the lecture brief as context
Check your own notes or Notion pages against the slides and transcript with evidence links
disambiguation: Named for the Alt (altalt.io) lecture app, not a general importer; it only imports lectures from Alt or an Alt share link.
extras: Desktop only (tested on macOS); needs Node 22.13+ inside Obsidian for node:sqlite; interface and generated notes are in Korean with academic terms in English; free but LLM features count against your Claude or ChatGPT plan; renamed from Alt2Obsidian before 2.0.0 with a separate plugin id migration path.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import Alt lectures or turn lecture recordings and slide PDFs into structured, linked study notes.
